Target_Riders.generation_method: Derived dynamically from Store_Type rider capacity ranges.

store_assignment_rules.logic: Every rider belongs to exactly one Dark Store. Every Store_ID must exist in darkstores.csv.

business_rules.name: Order Assignment Eligibility
business_rules.logic: Only Active riders are eligible for order assignment.

business_rules.name: Leave Status Handling
business_rules.logic: On Leave riders temporarily receive no orders.

business_rules.name: Store Mapping
business_rules.logic: Every rider must belong to exactly one Store_ID. Every Store_ID must exist.

business_rules.name: Historical Rating
business_rules.logic: Average_Rating represents historical customer feedback. Average_Rating represents the cumulative average customer rating across all completed deliveries up to the simulation start date. This is a static master attribute.

business_rules.name: Historical Delivery Time
business_rules.logic: Average_Delivery_Time_Min represents historical delivery performance. This is a static master attribute.

business_rules.name: Rider Name Generation
business_rules.logic: Generate realistic Indian names. Duplicate names are allowed with a maximum occurrence of 3. Do not allow duplicate Rider_Name + Store_ID combinations.

validation_rules.condition: Exactly one Rider_ID per rider. Unique Rider_ID.
Average_Rating must be between 3.0 and 5.0 inclusive.
Average_Delivery_Time_Min must be between 10.0 and 30.0 inclusive.
No NULL values allowed in any column.
Duplicate Rider_Name allowed only up to 3 times across the dataset.
